targets.title: The joy of thinking as the key to success? The importance of Need for Cognition for subjective experience and achievement in academic studies
targets.evidence_quote: One goal of this paper was to replicate the findings of Grass et al. (2018) in a teacher sample using a multiple mediation model on cross-sectional self-report data of teachers.
targets.outcome_quote: We could replicate the relation between the two emotion regulation strategies reappraisal and suppression with reduced personal efficacy , but not their association with NFC.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report replicated associations alongside associations that did not replicate; the mediation differed.

reasoning: New teacher sample re-tests the published student-teacher findings of Grass et al. (2018). Other citations motivate extensions rather than constitute designated replication targets.
